components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid azure CTA used across the data-facing pages.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 16px; background-color: #0A5FC4; padding: 10px 24px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ffffff; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: background-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #0B4FA6; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0A5FC4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Broadcast Card
components.description: The default data panel: soft rounded white card with an inset header strip and a soft rest shadow.
components.html:
Team honours

Winnings & awards

Prize-ladder money the organization took home.
components.css: .ds-card { overflow: hidden; border-radius: 24px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background-color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-card-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9; background-color: rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.5); padding: 20px 24px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #020617; } .ds-kicker { margin: 0; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0A5FC4; } .ds-card-body { padding: 24px; } .ds-body { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: #334155; }

components.name: Tinted Status Badge
components.description: Translucent hue tint with saturated text — the site's status language (azure / amber / emerald / rose).
components.html: BATTLEGROUNDS MOBILE INDIA CHAMPION ACTIVE
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: rgba(10, 95, 196, 0.1); color: #0A5FC4; padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-badge-amber { background-color: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.15); color: #b45309; } .ds-badge-emerald { background-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1); color: #059669; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Compact filter / segment chip with an azure selected state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background-color: #ffffff; color: #334155; padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-chip:hover { background-color: #f1f5f9; } .ds-chip-active { background-color: #0A5FC4; border-color: #0A5FC4; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Quiet, high-legibility field that lights azure on focus.
components.html: <input type="text" class="ds-input" placeholder="Search players, teams, tournaments..." />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background-color: #ffffff; color: #0f172a; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; outline: none; box-sizing: border-box; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #0A5FC4; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(10, 95, 196, 0.2); }

components.name: Navigation Tab
components.description: Underline tab; the active state is a 2px azure rule and azure label.
components.css: .ds-tab-strip { display: flex; gap: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; } .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 12px 2px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #64748b; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #0f172a; } .ds-tab-active { color: #0A5FC4; border-bottom-color: #0A5FC4; }

components.name: Live Pulse Indicator
components.description: Rose pill with a broadcast pulse for live tournament status.
components.css: .ds-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.1); color: #e11d48; padding: 3px 10px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-live-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: #f43f5e; animation: ds-pulse 1.8s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } 50% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scale(0.9); } }

narrative.overview:
eSportsAmaze looks like the production gallery of a live esports broadcast: confident, high-contrast, and built for scanning dense numbers under time pressure. The default building block is a soft rounded card — a pure white panel with a 16–24px radius, a 1px slate-200 border, and a gentle shadow-xs/shadow-sm lift at rest — sitting on a cool paper canvas. In dark mode the same cards become deep navy panels (#0b1220).

The energy comes from one bright signal colour, Broadcast Azure (#0A5FC4), used freely on links, active pills, CTAs and tinted /10 badges, plus a small broadcast accent set (champion amber, live rose, active emerald, special indigo) delivered as translucent tinted pills — never as flat card fills. Headlines are black-weight and uppercase with tight tracking; numbers are tabular.

The newsroom vertical (app/(public)/news/** and legal pages) runs a deliberately quieter editorial sub-style — the .ed-* primitives, #2452c2, hairline borders, no shadows — for long-form reading. That style is real but secondary; it must not be imposed on the data-facing pages.
keyCharacteristics: Soft Broadcast Cards: 16px / 24px radius, pure white (navy #0b1220 in dark), 1px slate-200 border, shadow-xs/sm at rest
Azure Signal: #0A5FC4 is the primary; #2452c2 is news-only
Navy Nightfall: dark mode is a specific navy #0b1220, never generic black
Broadcast Accent Pills: amber champion / rose live / emerald active / indigo special, as /10 tints
Tabular Precision: every points, rank and score figure is tabular-nums

rules.name: The Azure Signature Rule
rules.body: #0A5FC4 is the primary for every data-facing surface. Never substitute the newsroom #2452c2 on home, tournaments, teams, players, compare or rankings.

rules.name: The Tinted-Signal Rule
rules.body: Colour arrives as a translucent tint (bg-{hue}-500/10, bg-[#0A5FC4]/10, bg-amber-400/15) with saturated text on top. Never fill a whole card or section with a solid bright hue — the two gradient hero callouts are the only exceptions.

rules.name: The Champion Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber is earned, not decorative: it appears only for a winner, a 1st place, a podium, or a WWCD.

rules.name: The Black-Weight Rule
rules.body: Headings are font-black (900), generally uppercase with tight tracking. font-extrabold sentence-case is the editorial sub-style, not the default.

rules.name: The Tabular Precision Rule
rules.body: Points, ranks, finishes, times and money are tabular-nums font-semibold. Non-tabular figures in a data column are forbidden.

rules.name: The Kicker Rule
rules.body: A data card's title is preceded by an uppercase, wide-tracked micro-kicker in stone or azure.

rules.name: The Lift-On-Hover Rule
rules.body: A clickable card is flat-ish at rest and lifts (shadow + slight translate + azure border) on hover. Static info cards do not lift.

rules.name: The Newsroom-Is-Flat Rule
rules.body: The no-shadow, hairline-only treatment is valid only inside the editorial/news sub-style. Do not flatten data cards to hairlines.

dos: Do build data panels as soft rounded cards: rounded-2xl/rounded-3xl border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-xs/sm dark:border-white/10 dark:bg-[#0b1220].
Do use #0A5FC4 as the primary on all data-facing surfaces.
Do headline with font-black uppercase tracking-tight, and precede card titles with an uppercase wide-tracked kicker.
Do carry status as translucent /{opacity} tints (azure / amber / emerald / rose / indigo) with saturated text.
Do use tabular-nums on every figure in a data column, and shadow-xs/sm at rest with a hover lift on interactive cards.
Do keep the editorial/news sub-style (.ed-*, #2452c2, hairline, no shadow) confined to app/(public)/news/** and legal pages.
Do respect the 1320px max width and use .rail snap rails for wide matrices on mobile.
donts: Don't apply the newsroom's flat/hairline/no-shadow language to home, tournaments, teams, players, compare or rankings.
Don't use #2452c2 (--ed-blue) as the primary outside the news sub-style.
Don't fill a whole card or section with a solid bright colour; cover with a /{10} tint instead.
Don't use shadow-free 12px cards as the default container on data surfaces, and don't drop the dark:bg-[#0b1220] pairing.
Don't use font-extrabold sentence-case headings on game pages, or decorative mono for non-data text.
Don't render non-tabular numbers in standings, scorecards, prize tables or rankings.
